a.aria-label: UniProtKB:Q2RXI1 — has_cofactor → CHEBI:48828; subject molecular state: Recombinant R. rubrum Ald2 apoenzyme after EDTA treatment and dialysis, separately reconstituted with 0.1 mM Co2+ for one hour. (//passage[41]); Evidence PMID:31950558: Apoenzymes were prepared by 24-hour EDTA dialysis followed by 24-hour Chelex-treated buffer dialysis; individual metals were added at 0.1 mM for one hour before activity measurement.
